scope: Development diagnostic, not an untouched holdout or production-wide accuracy estimate. Eight distinct public original images, four per country, with three fresh-profile runs in the final round. No source expectations are sent to the parser. No real customer files or existing confirmed transactions were modified.
sourceAudit: Original baseline incorrectly treated country as proof of currency and expected all images to save transactions. Visual inspection established that all CORD dates are redacted; KR 01/19 and all four CORD images lack explicit currency. Totals and image bytes were unchanged. Corrected source-derived outcomes were fixed before final-v1 and retained through all follow-up rounds. Baseline below is a separately reviewed record, not an overwrite of the original raw responses.

baseline.method: Post-run source audit of the original unchanged baseline. Totals are evaluated from persisted receipt documents, not only transactions. Four CORD images have obscured dates; Korean 01 and 19 lack explicit currency. Source-derived review expectations are separate from numeric total extraction. The original raw baseline report is retained and is not overwritten.

liveIterations.label: final-v1
liveIterations.method: Eight public original diagnostic images through real staging authenticated multipart uploads, R2 persistence, queue, AI provider and database reads. Fresh isolated QA Profile per round prevents workspace extraction-cache and duplicate reuse. Neutral filenames; expected data never sent to parser. Exact totals evaluated from persisted receipt documents. Source audit: all four CORD images have deliberately obscured dates, so correct outcome is explicit terminal review with no transaction and no retry; country is not used as proof of currency. Two Korean images explicitly show Won and must save a transaction; the other two lack printed currency and must require review. Expected outcomes were fixed by visual source inspection before these runs. Client time includes token issuance, upload and <=1s polling. Server time is upload timestamp to transaction creation or terminal review update. This small development set is not an independent accuracy estimate or validation of every field.

completeControls.method: Two clearly labeled Clover-authored synthetic receipt images rendered from the existing hashed text fixtures, through normal staging uploads and saved-transaction reads. No real customer documents. Explicit currency, date, merchant, type, category and total checked independently.

localRegression.method: Sequential, disk inputs preloaded; one first invocation followed by repeated warm calls; correctness assertions excluded from timing. Workbook and legacy-byte decoding included. No network, OCR, model, queue, persistence or end-to-end upload timing. Development corpus, not independent holdout.

limitations: Only total, explicit-currency handling, terminal review, and saved-transaction outcomes are scored for the eight originals. All merchant names, item rows and categories are not exhaustively scored. Two separate complete synthetic images check amount, currency, date, merchant, expense type and category.
All four public Indonesian images require review because dates are obscured. The synthetic IDR positive control separately proves the complete saved-transaction path.
Local OCR alone still fails accuracy: only 1/8 original-image totals consistently exact. Cloud AI backup is required for this diagnostic set. The local-only report is retained separately.
Latency covers server upload-to-outcome and client upload/polling, not device UI rendering. p95 on 24 attempts is a small-sample statistic, not a service-level guarantee.
No device gesture, production upload, store build or production deployment was exercised by this benchmark.
Model extraction remains nondeterministic. These source-derived regressions do not eliminate errors on unfamiliar layouts.
